notes.title: v1.8 Minor fixes introduced in v1.7
notes.content: Minor fixes caused by changes in v1.7, also added rock smash animation

notes.title: Update notes for version 1.7
notes.content:
Added leaderboard screen as well as other minor fixes:
- Updated ray tracing for faster speeds
- Changed water dampen factor to be based on current speed
- Increased lighting on storm level

notes.title: v1.6
notes.content: This release adds a new storm level. Please note that there is a photo sensitivity warning due to flashing lights.

notes.title: First Update! v1.5
notes.content:
Excuse the huge jump in versions, they will be sorted out in the future! This is the first update for Outrun Them. It's been so much fun working on this project and I hope that you get some enjoyment out of it. Please send me any issues encountered or suggestions for improvements!
[list]
[*] Added top scores to main screen (for light level only)
[*] Added a player inventory system
[*] Created pickupable items
[*] Added a new level (unlocked when a certain achievement is met)
[*] Improved some quality of life issues
[/list]
